resources.instructions: Work on branch dexter/appreciation-categories and open a PR to main. Author code + SQL files ONLY — do NOT run psql/migrations or vercel deploy (no prod creds in the worker). Dexter applies migrations + deploys after review.

resources.text: Implement the feature specified in research/SPEC-appreciation-categories.md in this repo. Build the four categorized appreciation lanes on /appreciating: the Trending line-chart gallery already exists (keep it as the default lane); ADD three event-driven lanes — Appreciation Stories (serial resold cheap->expensive, pattern 2), Floor-Smashed (low ask leapt >=1.5x in 30d, pattern 3), and High-Value Illiquid (floor>=$200 with <=5 sales/90d, no chart, pattern 4). Create the three materialized views, paginated read wrappers, and card components exactly as the spec defines, and add the MVs to scripts/etl/bq-refresh-mvs.mjs. The spec's constraints are HARD: code + SQL authoring + PR only; PostgREST aggregates are disabled (use MVs/SECURITY DEFINER RPCs); paginate all reads; cross-check every displayed number against an independent query and put that verification in the PR body. Open the PR to main from dexter/appreciation-categories.
